assumptions: Independent EPANET engine reference, not the civil implementation.
Hazen-Williams water hydraulics with input options recorded below.

provenance.engine_input_note: WNTR serializes the imported model to an EPANET 2.2 INP before calling the compiled toolkit; the fixture itself is not replaced by that serialization.
provenance.source: EPA EPANET Example Network 1 bundled with WNTR 1.5.0

license.input_note: EPA example distributed as part of WNTR; complete installed WNTR/EPANET notices preserved in the INP comment header.

derivations: headloss_m is signed upstream head_m minus downstream head_m, using the reported node heads; pumps therefore have negative headloss_m.
reported_headloss is the WNTR-converted EPANET binary value: m/m pipe gradient, m pump or valve headloss.
Tank level_m is reported head_m minus model tank elevation_m.
requested_demand_m3s comes from WNTR expected_demand(base demands, patterns, multiplier); delivered_demand_m3s is EPANET binary node demand.
EPANET reservoir/tank demand_m3s is signed exchange flow, not customer demand.
controls: IF TANK 2 LEVEL BELOW 33.528 THEN PUMP 9 STATUS IS OPEN PRIORITY 3
IF TANK 2 LEVEL ABOVE 42.672000000000004 THEN PUMP 9 STATUS IS CLOSED PRIORITY 3
provenance.result_numeric_precision: EPANET binary output stores float32; JSON preserves the converted output without decimal rounding.
provenance.input_modification: Only semicolon-comment provenance/license header prepended; original file bytes retained.
provenance.coordinate_note: Original map coordinates retained; BACKDROP UNITS None, so they are diagram coordinates with no surveyed CRS or asserted physical length units.
provenance.quality_note: Original chlorine/reaction options retained and EPANET runs quality, but this fixture records hydraulic results only.
